title: Navitas and NVIDIA's 24kW GaN Power Board: What the Move to 800VDC Means
excerpt: A beginner-friendly look at the GaN power board from Navitas and NVIDIA, which can deliver 24kW by converting 800VDC to 12VDC in a single stage. We cover the technical background, target performance, how it differs from mass production, and what to check next.
